reserveReview.rationale: The immediate reserve relationship is M, not an independently measured Treasury portfolio or a wM reserve. Streamflow's integration derives an M vault under its USD+ extension. Its associated M vault 67GWo9en5KtPfeZn5LWrCyhL2w31rf1oqeCoszPUKsAs held 1452718753516 raw principal units at six decimals. The same-slot M scaled-UI multiplier was 1.100820601948, giving approximately 1599182.732707 indexed M units against 1599062.791523 minted USD+. This is a dated technical backing observation, not independent financial assurance, circulating supply or continuous reserve coverage. The single slice expresses the reviewed immediate M backing architecture; it is not a measured 100% Treasury allocation. Source/executable equivalence, alternate mint paths and the full upstream custody partition remain unresolved. The underlying legacy M mint differs from M's current catalog deployment and is retained here as exact reserve-read provenance, not an additional catalog deployment or a claim of migration completion.
